sources.read_locators: Text Evaluation / Characters / Levenshtein Distance / Character Error Rate; Layout Evaluation / Reading Order
sources.read_summary: Read the standard CER=(i+s+d)/n with n=GT characters, minimum single-character insert/delete/substitute edits, and distinct layout/reading-order evaluation. OCR-D itself uses grapheme clusters in NFC and a separately normalized CER; those are not silently imposed on the course's codepoint metric.

Read canonical versus compatibility equivalence, NFKC compatibility decomposition followed by canonical composition, width variants, and warning about erasing formatting/semantic distinctions. Runtime UCD is 15.1.0; the reported example mappings were also directly executed.
